column1: # The el8 packages the probe stands on, pinned by checksum.
# role   sysroot, unpacked and put on the loader path so el8 elfdeps runs;
#        or ref, unpacked and only ever read as an input file. The vendor
#        glibc is ref on purpose: its libc.so.6 is what elfdeps is pointed
#        at, and putting a 2.28 libc on the loader path of a host running
#        2.43 would break every process the probe starts.
